content: Cimetidine increases the level or effect of ivabradine by inhibiting the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors should be avoided or alternative drugs should be used. Ivacaftor increases the levels of cimetidine by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Co-administration should be avoided or alternative drugs should be considered. Ivacaftor and its M1 metabolite may inhibit P-gp, potentially increasing systemic exposure to sensitive P-gp substrates with a narrow therapeutic index. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of ixabepilone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine decreases the level or effect of ketoconazole by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Lasmiditan increases the levels of cimetidine through an unspecified mechanism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Lasmiditan inhibits BCRP in vitro, so co-administration with BCRP substrates should be avoided. Leniolisib increases the level or effect of cimetidine by inhibiting BCRP. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Leniolisib may increase systemic exposure to BCRP substrates. Cimetidine decreases the level or effect of levoketoconazole by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the effects of levomethadone by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of lonafarnib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. If co-administration with weak CYP3A inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the lonafarnib dose to the starting dose and monitor closely for arrhythmias and other cardiac events. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of lopinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of loratadine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of lovastatin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of lumefantrine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of maraviroc by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the effects of meperidine by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of mestranol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of methadone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and decreasing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of midazolam by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the effects of morphine by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the effects of nalbuphine by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of nelfinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine decreases the level or effect of neratinib by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of nicardipine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of nilotinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of nimodipine by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of nisoldipine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of olaparib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. If co-administration with moderate CYP3A inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the olaparib dose to 200 mg (capsule) or 150 mg (tablet) twice daily. Do not substitute tablets with capsules. Cimetidine increases the effects of opium tincture by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the effects of oxycodone by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the effects of oxymorphone by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the effects of papaveretum by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine decreases the level or effect of pazopanib by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Consider using short-acting antacids instead of PPIs and H2 antagonists, and separate antacid and pazopanib dosing by several hours. Cimetidine increases the effects of pentazocine by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of pexidartinib by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Separate pexidartinib dosing by 2 hours before or 10 hours after taking an H2 antagonist. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of pirfenidone by inhibiting CYP1A2 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is unavoidable, decrease the dose of pirfenidone. Cimetidine decreases the levels of ponatinib by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of prednisone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of procainamide by competing for renal tubular clearance as a basic (cationic) drug. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of quetiapine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of quinidine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Quinidine also increases the level or effect of cimetidine by competing for renal tubular clearance as a basic (cationic) drug. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of ranolazine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of repaglinide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of risedronate by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents and specifically to the delayed-release formulation. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of ritonavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of romidepsin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine may cause a hyperresponse in gastrin secretion during secretin stimulation testing, falsely suggesting gastrinoma. Discontinue H2 receptor antagonists at least 2 days before administering secretin to aid in the diagnosis of gastrinoma. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of silodosin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of simvastatin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of sirolimus by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of solifenacin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine decreases the level or effect of sotorasib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Sotorasib also decreases the level or effect of cimetidine by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine decreases the effects of sparsentan by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the effects of sufentanil by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of sunitinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of tacrolimus by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Tafenoquine increases the level or effect of cimetidine by inhibiting organic cation transporter-2 (OCT2) and multidrug and toxin extrusion (MATE) transporters. Avoid co-administration with OCT2 or MATE substrates. If co-administration is unavoidable, monitor for substrate-related toxicities and consider dosage reduction based on product labeling. Cimetidine increases the effects of tapentadol by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of temsirolimus by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Tepotinib increases the level or effect of cimetidine by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of theophylline by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of thioridazine by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of tipranavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of tizanidine by inhibiting CYP1A2 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the levels of tofacitinib by decreasing its metabolism. Reduce the tofacitinib dose to 5 mg once daily when co-administered with medications that result in both moderate CYP3A4 inhibition and potent CYP2C19 inhibition. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of tolterodine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of tolvaptan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of triamcinolone acetonide injectable suspension by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of triazolam by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Trilaciclib decreases the level or effect of cimetidine by inhibiting OCT2, MATE1, and MATE-2K transporters. Avoid co-administration with substrates where minimal increased concentration in the kidney or blood may lead to serious or life-threatening toxicities. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of verapamil by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine increases the levels of vilazodone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. If intolerable adverse effects occur, reduce the daily dose to 20 mg. Cimetidine increases the effects of warfarin through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Cimetidine decreases the levels of acalabrutinib by increasing gastric pH. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Acalabrutinib solubility decreases with increasing gastric pH. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of alfentanil by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of alfuzosin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of alosetron by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of amitriptyline by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Apalutamide decreases the level or effect of cimetidine by increasing its elimination. Use caution and monitor closely. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of armodafinil by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of atazanavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of atogepant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Cimetidine increases the level or effect of atomoxetine by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely.
